properties.name: archone.messaging.observation.enabled
properties.description: Whether messaging producer and consumer observations are composed when an ObservationRegistry bean exists. This does not select or install an exporter.

properties.name: archone.messaging.observation.producer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to observe synchronous Outbox append attempts through the producer interceptor lifecycle.

properties.name: archone.messaging.observation.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Whether to observe final semantic outcomes through the ordered consumer decorator chain.

properties.name: archone.messaging.jpa.enabled
properties.description: Whether to compose the legacy JPA Outbox bridge and JPA Inbox fallback beans.

properties.name: archone.messaging.producer.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to compose the transaction-required JDBC Outbox MessageProducer.

properties.name: archone.messaging.consumer.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to compose the JDBC Inbox duplicate detector, transactional idempotency decorator, and legacy InboxRepo bridge.

properties.name: archone.messaging.jpa.register-package
properties.description: Whether to add the Archone messaging root to Spring Boot auto-configuration packages. Disable when the application root already covers it.
